profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at YouVersion
profile.summary:
Software engineering has become an integral aspect of life empowering me to solve problems as they come.

When I'm not working I enjoy reading philosophy, playing soccer, embarking on adventures and occasionally the good ol' movie binge. While computer science seems to be at odds with spirituality, I've found an awesome union between science and theology. 

Lastly, I love learning, collaboration and problem solving.

Languages: Swift, Kotlin, Python, Solidity
Frameworks: Xcode, Intelli J, Git, Firebase(no SQL), Heroku, Parse (SQL), JSON, API, RESTful
Professional: LEAN Product Development, AGILE, Scrum, Sketch, Keynote

positions.title: Blockchain Developer
positions.description:
With the explosion of the mobile gaming phenomenon, there exists a huge space for competitive gaming with blockchain based rewards. MOA seeks to disrupt the competitive mobile gaming industry by creating the first autonomous gaming platform with features such as automated in-game escrow services, automated ranking systems and automated tournaments.

Our vision is that MOA will become the go-to platform for mobile gamers seeking a premiere gaming experience. By creating an ecosystem that is fair, affordable, and devoid of centralized control, MOA will not only provide the best service for its users but also outcompete other offerings that require huge infrastructures and high ongoing costs to maintain.

projects.title: Assist ASD - An iOS application to help children with Autism
projects.description:
Lead idea formation
User interviewed 7+ Behavioral Therapist from Center for Autism Related Disorders
Authored user stories of multiple perspectives and user narrative of functionality
Created and programmed Wire frames and User Experience for iOS Application
Program and implemented Google's Cloud Vision Machine Learning for mood/emotion recognition

projects.title: Joshua Guide - A chat bot to aide the homeless
projects.description:
Researched homelessness data in San Francisco. User interviewed homeless and staff  at St. Anthony’s Tech Lab
Created Back Logs, user narratives and user stories. Went through 5 sprints
Growth/testing discussions with St. Anthony’s Foundation 
Responsible for data structuring, creating JSON data, managing button functionality, string manipulation with Reg EX
